mainText: Hello, Verona! At 9 AM, here is today's balanced dish: we have overcast skies at Verona Area High School and the moon is in its First Quarter phase.

The City of Verona has announced they are hiring an Engineering Technician to oversee public infrastructure projects, with a deadline of September 20. Additionally, residents can now apply for the rain barrel rebate program to receive credits on their utility bills.

We have a packed schedule with Live Music at Bailey's Run and Wisconsin Brewing Company happening today. Tomorrow, you can visit the Dane County Farmer's Market or catch more live music at Paddy Mac's.
In a report from Friday, August 15, Verona police stopped and arrested a 44-year-old woman for a first offence O W I after she was found passed out behind the wheel.
The flavor of the day is Peanut Butter Fudge Brownie. Culver's is currently closed but will open its doors at 10 AM, so get ready to enjoy a tasty treat.
